tunnel install uses an owner-token exclusive coordination lock across final snapshot and both managed-file writes
authenticated resumable downloads enforce caller maxBytes and total timeout within the signed 1 GiB cap
residualLimitations: The tunnel lock coordinates cooperating installers only; arbitrary external editors can still ignore it
The tunnel executable and manifest remain separate atomic replacements
A cancellation timeout preserves tempRoot for recovery rather than proving worker termination
requiredCrossLaneIntegration: Lane 5 must await updateController.cancelInstall(launch) in main.cjs
